name: open.mp (GTA: San Andreas)
description: Open Multiplayer — the SA-MP-compatible multiplayer mod for GTA: San Andreas. Official server package downloaded from GitHub.

install.command: cp -r Server/* . && rm -rf Server && chmod +x omp-server

variables.label: open.mp release tag
variables.description: GitHub release tag used in the download URL (github.com/openmultiplayer/open.mp/releases). Re-run install after changing it.

notes: The server is a 32-bit binary — 64-bit hosts need 32-bit runtime libraries (Debian/Ubuntu: apt install libc6-i386 lib32stdc++6 lib32atomic1). All settings live in config.json; the package ships with Pawn gamemodes (gungame is the default main script — change pawn.main_scripts to switch). Legacy SA-MP gamemodes and most plugins are compatible. Save variables here, then adjust the rest of config.json in the file manager.
